verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart lists speaker diarization as a request option that will "separate the speakers across the conversation," so the core capability is documented first-party. The evidence is a single brief mention, and it never shows how speakers appear in the transcript output. missing for 10: documented output schema showing per-utterance speaker labels, evidence of diarization in live/real-time mode, configuration details (e.g., speaker count hints), independent or hands-on corroboration.
